# FoxURL

FoxURL is a browser-based digital utility ecosystem with the brand position "innovate your connection." The active public site uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and presents focused products for link sharing, device-to-device transfer, account access, and network utilities.

## Primary pages
- https://foxurl.github.io/
- https://foxurl.github.io/cloud/products/
- https://foxurl.github.io/cloud/
- https://foxurl.github.io/FoxBox/
- https://foxurl.github.io/premuim/
- https://foxurl.github.io/login/
- https://foxurl.github.io/login/email/
- https://foxurl.github.io/login/passkey/
- https://foxurl.github.io/login/google/
- https://foxurl.github.io/login/github/
- https://foxurl.github.io/recovery/
- https://foxurl.github.io/404.html
- https://foxurl.github.io/offline.html

## Homepage
https://foxurl.github.io/ presents FoxURL, links to the products catalog and sign-in hub, and identifies FoxLink and FoxBox as the two primary products.

## FoxLink
FoxLink is the external link-shortening and URL-sharing product.

- Link: https://fxlnk.github.io/
- Purpose: safe, simple URL shortening and sharing

## FoxBox
FoxBox is the on-site utility for sending text and links between devices.

- Page: https://foxurl.github.io/FoxBox/
- Purpose: quick cross-device transfer of text snippets and URLs
- Interaction: text/link entry and sharing workflows in the browser

## Products catalog
https://foxurl.github.io/cloud/products/ lists FoxLink and FoxBox with short descriptions and direct links.

## FoxURL Account / Cloud
https://foxurl.github.io/cloud/ is the account dashboard and utility portal. It currently combines account and browser-session information with security, privacy, weather, and connection tools.

Features include:
- signed-in email and account status
- sign-in method and session details
- security health and sign-in method checks
- breach and privacy monitoring by email address
- weather and forecast information near the user's location
- network speed, latency, packet-loss, and upload timing tests
- account and test-related browser state

The dashboard uses browser storage and external services for identity, weather, breach, and network functionality.

## Authentication
https://foxurl.github.io/login/ is the sign-in hub.

Available sign-in options:
- Email code: https://foxurl.github.io/login/email/
- Passkey: https://foxurl.github.io/login/passkey/
- Google: https://foxurl.github.io/login/google/
- GitHub: https://foxurl.github.io/login/github/
- GitLab sign-in is implemented directly by the login hub

Account recovery:
- https://foxurl.github.io/recovery/
- submits a human-review request through a Google Forms endpoint
- asks for account and contact email addresses and optional sign-in details
- warns users not to submit passwords, codes, tokens, or other secrets

## Premium
https://foxurl.github.io/premuim/ describes FoxURL Premium.

The current public perks page advertises email aliases, personal email storage, early access, experimental features, and a more personal support experience.

## Support pages
- https://foxurl.github.io/404.html is the navigation error page.
- https://foxurl.github.io/offline.html is the offline fallback and includes a browser Pong game.

## Technical model
The public site is primarily static:
- HTML defines page structure and content
- CSS provides the FoxURL visual system
- JavaScript provides account state, authentication interactions, dashboards, sharing, and diagnostics
- browser storage is used for some local account and session state
- Google, GitHub, GitLab, external weather, breach, and network services are used where relevant

## Exclusions
The /legacy/ directory and every page beneath it are excluded. It contains historical, experimental, archived, and superseded material and is not part of the active public site description.
